subject.title: fix: copilot token cache ignores profile rotation on rate limit

question: Should maintainers keep waiting for the contributor to rebase this PR and provide real Copilot profile-rotation proof, or adopt the fix in a fresh maintainer branch?
rationale: The PR is assigned, conflicting, and proof-gated; automation cannot decide whether to adopt the stale external branch or supply the contributor's real credential-rotation evidence.

options.title: Ask for rebase and proof
options.body: Have the contributor move the fix to `src/plugin-sdk/provider-auth.ts`, update current tests, and add redacted real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Adopt a replacement
options.body: A maintainer can use this PR as source context and open a narrow replacement branch if the linked bug is urgent.

options.title: Pause until response
options.body: Keep the PR open while assigned, then reconsider cleanup only if maintainer engagement ends and the contributor does not respond.
